-- class: contract
-- name: init

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-role
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create role "app_48f3af47af04" with nosuperuser nocreatedb nocreaterole inherit nologin;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "okm" in schema "public" revoke execute on functions from public;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "okm" in schema "public" grant execute on functions to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "okm" in schema "public" grant select on sequences to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "okm" in schema "public" grant usage on sequences to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "okm" in schema "public" grant delete on tables to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "okm" in schema "public" grant insert on tables to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "okm" in schema "public" grant select on tables to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "okm" in schema "public" grant update on tables to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" bigint generated always as identity not null,
  "status" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create function "public"."is_open"("status" text) returns boolean language sql immutable security invoker as $okm$select status <> 'done'$okm$;

-- class: contract
-- kind: revoke
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
revoke execute on function "public"."is_open"(text) from public;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant execute on function "public"."is_open"(text) to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on sequence "public"."tasks_id_seq" to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant usage on sequence "public"."tasks_id_seq" to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant delete on table "public"."tasks" to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant insert on table "public"."tasks" to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."tasks" to "app_48f3af47af04";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant update on table "public"."tasks" to "app_48f3af47af04";
